notes: Pop-ups: notifications now show as Couch Launcher pop-ups, top right, above games and everything else, instead of Windows notifications (Settings › Controllers to turn off, try one, or mute the sound). Discord on screen: your call shows top left, with who's in it lit up while they talk, and Discord's message notifications can show as pop-ups (needs Discord's permission: Settings › Controllers › Discord messages as pop-ups › Allow in Discord).
